privacy_policy.title: Personal Data Protection Policy
privacy_policy.subtitle: NST COIL CENTER (THAILAND) LTD.
privacy_policy.intro: NST COIL CENTER (THAILAND) LTD. a group of Nippon Steel Trading Corporation (collectively referred to as the "Company") recognize the importance of protection of personal data. Therefore, we have issued our Personal Data Protection Policy in order to prescribe the process of personal data protection in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act, B.E. 2562.
privacy_policy.sec_1_desc: This Policy applies to employees working with the company, including who’s involved in doing business with the Company that must be protected to protect personal information.
privacy_policy.sec_2_desc: “Personal Data” means information about a person which enables identification of such person, whether Directly or Indirectly... (including Direct, Indirect, Sensitive Data, Processing, Data Subject, Data Controller, Data Processor, Data Protection Officer, and Cookies).
privacy_policy.sec_3_title: 3. Collection and Retention of Personal Data
privacy_policy.sec_3_desc: The company will collect personal Data within the purpose, scope that comply with the law which the company will notify to the Data Subject. Collected information includes: Personal information, Contact Information, Work/Education history, Website usage & Cookies, Marketing Data, Sensitive information, Location Data, and CCTV Footage.
privacy_policy.sec_4_title: 4. Objectives for collecting and using Personal Data
privacy_policy.sec_4_desc: The company will Collect and/or Use the Personal Data for company operations, communication, analysis, and improving efficiency in accordance with the law. Exceptions apply for preventing danger to life, contract performance, public missions, legitimate interests, or legal compliance.
privacy_policy.sec_5_desc: The Company will disclose personal data only with consent, except when necessary for business operations. Data may be disclosed to Affiliates (NST Group), Contractual parties, Government Regulators, or related organizations.
privacy_policy.sec_6_desc: The company will define measures to protect personal data with security as required by law. Data will be retained as specified by law (e.g., Accounting Act, Computer-Related Offenses Act) and will be deleted or anonymized when no longer necessary.
privacy_policy.sec_7_title: 7. Sending or transferring Personal Data abroad
privacy_policy.sec_7_desc: The Company must ensure that destination countries have adequate personal data protection standards. If not, it will comply with legal exceptions.
privacy_policy.sec_8_desc: The Company has established appropriate security measures to prevent Loss, Access, Use, Alteration, Correction or Disclosure of Personal data without authorization.
privacy_policy.sec_9_desc: The Data Subject is entitled to: Right to withdraw consent, access data, request copies, rectify/delete/anonymize data, restrict use, transfer data, and object to processing. Requests will be considered within 30 days.
privacy_policy.sec_10_desc: The Company may review and revise this Policy to ensure adherence to laws and business changes. The Company shall expressly announce any amended policy.

types.title: Steel Types & Materials
types.subtitle: Specifications and properties for appropriate applications
types.hot_rolled_desc: Hot rolling is a metalworking process that occurs above the recrystallization temperature of the material. This prevents the metal from work hardening. While the finished product is of good quality, the surface is covered in mill scale. Typical uses include truck frames, automotive wheels, pipes, and metal buildings.
types.cold_rolled_desc: Cold rolling occurs with the metal below its recrystallization temperature (usually at room temperature), which increases the strength via strain hardening up to 20%. It improves surface finish and holds tighter tolerances. Typical uses include metal furniture, home appliances, and automotive components.
types.galvanize_desc: Galvanization is the process of applying a protective zinc coating to steel to prevent rusting. The most common method is hot-dip galvanizing. The zinc serves as a sacrificial anode so that even if the coating is scratched, the exposed steel will still be protected.
types.electro_galv_desc: A process where a layer of zinc is bonded to steel using electroplating. Compared to hot dip galvanizing, electroplated zinc offers lower thickness deposits, broader conversion coating availability, and brighter, more aesthetically appealing deposits.
types.aluminized_desc: Steel hot-dip coated with an aluminium-silicon alloy. It shows better behavior against corrosion and keeps base material properties for temperatures up to 800°C (1,470°F). It transfers heat faster, making it useful for furnaces, automotive mufflers, and water heaters.
types.stainless_desc: Stainless steel differs from carbon steel by the amount of chromium present. It contains sufficient chromium to form a passive film of chromium oxide, which prevents further surface corrosion. It does not readily corrode, rust, or stain with water.
types.aluminum_desc: A silvery-white, soft, nonmagnetic, ductile metal. Aluminium is remarkable for its low density and ability to resist corrosion. It is vital to the aerospace industry and important in transportation and structural building facades.
types.color_steel_desc: Pre-painted steel sheet coated with layers of paint and baked at high temperatures for aesthetic appeal and enhanced resistance to UV and weather conditions. Commonly used for roofing (metal sheets), architectural wall panels, and decorative components.
